title.ja: 単回帰・共分散・相関
title.en: Simple linear regression, covariance and correlation

summary.ja: 単一データソースの数値2列から、グループ別OLS単回帰・共分散・Pearson相関を決定的に計算する。切片あり/原点固定、SSE、自由度、残差標準偏差、centered/uncentered R²を区別する。 指定観測の実測値・当てはめ値・個別残差も全体回帰後に取得できる。
summary.en: Grouped ordinary least squares, Pearson correlation and sample covariance for two numeric columns. Includes intercept or through-origin models, residual diagnostics, predictions and both R-squared conventions. Also retrieves observed/fitted values and an individual residual by observation_index after fitting the full group.

ja: 数値2列の回帰係数、相関、分散・共分散が必要
時点列のない観測データにも使用できる
en: OLS regression, covariance, variance or Pearson correlation of two numeric columns

ja: 多変量回帰・非線形回帰

description.ja: 対象グループをカンマ区切りで指定。省略で全グループ。
description.en: Comma-separated group values; omit for all groups.

description.ja: xがこの値の観測だけを除外。省略で除外なし。
description.en: Exclude observations whose x equals this number. Omit for no exclusion.

description.ja: yがこの値の観測だけを除外。省略で除外なし。
description.en: Exclude observations whose y equals this number. Omit for no exclusion.

description.ja: この説明変数xで予測値を計算。省略で予測なし。
description.en: Compute prediction at this predictor x; omit for no prediction.

description.ja: 群内の入力行順で1始まりの観測番号。全有効ペアで回帰した後、この観測の実測値・当てはめ値・残差を返す。除外後の行順。任意のID列とは異なる。省略で観測照会なし。
description.en: One-based input row ordinal within a group after exclusion filters. Fit ALL valid pairs first, then return observationX, observationY, fitted and residual=observed y minus fitted. This is not an arbitrary ID column. Omit for no observation query.

description.ja: グループごとに y=intercept+slope*x の最小二乗回帰を計算します。nは有効ペア数、missingPairsは欠測除外数。sampleVarianceX/Y・sampleCovarianceはn-1の標本分散・共分散、correlationはPearson相関です。sseは残差平方和、dfは切片ありn-2・原点固定n-1、residualStddev=sqrt(sse/df)。r2は切片ありでcenteredR2、原点固定でuncenteredR2を採用し両方を明示します。識別できなければstatus=not_identifiableと係数null。predict_xを渡すとpredictionX・predictionを丸めなしの係数から計算します。相関から因果を断定しないでください。 observation_indexで指定した観測のobservationX/observationY/fitted/residualを返す。回帰は全有効ペアを使い、観測だけに絞ってから再計算しない。
description.en: Returns one row per group. slope/intercept fit y=intercept+slope*x. n counts finite pairs; missingPairs are excluded pairwise. sampleVarianceX/Y and sampleCovariance use n-1; correlation is Pearson. sse is residual sum of squares; df=n-2 with intercept, n-1 through origin; residualStddev=sqrt(sse/df). r2 uses centeredR2 for include and uncenteredR2 for zero; both conventions are returned explicitly. status=not_identifiable and null coefficients when x cannot identify the model. Never infer causation. No intermediate rounding. Pass predict_x to obtain predictionX and prediction directly from the fitted model, without rounding coefficients or mental arithmetic. Pass observation_index to obtain the original observed pair, fitted value and residual for a specific row without refitting on that row. Use residual directly; never guess observed y from coefficients.
